subject.title: fix(skills): forward owner handle to bulk security-verdict fetch for ambiguous slugs

question: Which owner-qualified security-verdict contract should OpenClaw support when ClawHub bulk lookup reports an ambiguous or missing slug: an owner-aware bulk API, or a bounded fallback to single-skill verify?
rationale: The current external bulk contract is contradicted by the proposed mock, and introducing a fallback changes runtime network and failure behavior that repository policy treats as a product decision.

options.title: Define owner-aware bulk support
options.body: Coordinate an accepted ClawHub bulk request/response contract for `ownerHandle`, then add live contract proof and retain this direct bulk path.

options.title: Use a bounded verify fallback
options.body: On the documented owner-qualified ambiguity failure, call the existing verify endpoint with explicit limits, error mapping, and regression coverage for both bulk and fallback behavior.

options.title: Pause the client patch
options.body: Leave the current behavior unchanged until either contract is explicitly owned and can be demonstrated against the service.

recommendation.title: Define owner-aware bulk support
recommendation.body: Coordinate an accepted ClawHub bulk request/response contract for `ownerHandle`, then add live contract proof and retain this direct bulk path.

likelyOwner.reason: They need to select the client behavior and coordinate the external ClawHub contract boundary.
